purpose: Diagnose whether the spatial scale at which the frozen, unmodified Model 3 dense Q field is summarized affects (a) anatomical correspondence (Stage 11-style) and (b) rotation consistency (Stage 12-style). Purely diagnostic -- does not alter Stage 11/12's frozen official verdicts, does not retrain or modify Model 3, does not select or promote a 'best' scale.

frozen_artifacts_used_read_only.note: Stage 4 anatomical target fields are not re-read directly in this stage -- the anatomical target (q1_t, q2_t, valid) is obtained via the SAME resolution-matched, downsampled representation already produced by model3_loss.py::downsample_target_for_loss inside the existing, unmodified Stage 11 get_predictions() pipeline, exactly as Stage 11 itself used it. No new target generation occurs.

the_dense_prediction_is_computed_once: The frozen checkpoint's dense (B,2,H2,W2) q output is computed exactly once per population (angle=0 for the anatomy analysis; once per rotation angle for the rotation analysis) via the unmodified Stage 9/11 inference pipeline. All 6 scales are then produced by applying 6 different DETERMINISTIC, FIXED spatial reductions to that SAME dense array -- no additional model forward passes are introduced per scale, and no scale involves any change to the model, checkpoint, or preprocessing.

scales.name: center_pixel
scales.window: 1x1, centered at (H2//2, W2//2) = (32,32) of the 64x64 dense field
scales.aggregation_rule: no averaging: q1,q2 at the single center pixel
scales.boundary_rule: N/A (single interior pixel, no boundary case possible for a 64x64 field)
scales.reproduces: Stage 12's exact center-pixel rotation-consistency measurement (rotation analysis only); this is a NEW measurement for the anatomy analysis (Stage 11 never used center-pixel).

scales.name: 3x3_mean
scales.aggregation_rule: unweighted arithmetic mean of q1 and q2 independently over the 9 pixels, exactly matching the vector-space averaging convention already used throughout this project (per_patch_scalar_qs, Stage 12/14) -- S and phi are derived AFTER averaging (q1,q2), never by averaging S or phi directly
scales.boundary_rule: window fully interior for a 64x64 field with an 8-16px margin at this size; no clipping is triggered, but the documented fallback rule (had it been needed) is: clip the window to the array bounds and average over the clipped (in-bounds) pixels only

scales.name: 5x5_mean
scales.boundary_rule: same fallback rule as scale 1; not triggered

scales.name: 9x9_mean
scales.boundary_rule: same fallback rule as scale 1; not triggered

scales.name: 17x17_mean
scales.boundary_rule: same fallback rule as scale 1; not triggered (17x17 still fits with an 8px margin inside the 64x64 field)

scales.name: full_field
scales.aggregation_rule_anatomy_analysis: 'full VALID-field spatial mean' -- vector-space mean of (q1,q2) over exactly the anatomically-valid, resolution-matched pixels of that patch (model3_loss.py's existing all-4-valid downsampling rule) -- this is IDENTICAL, unchanged, to Stage 11's original per-patch reduction (per_patch_scalar_qs). Included here specifically so Scale 5's anatomy numbers reproduce Stage 11's original result exactly, as an internal consistency check.
scales.aggregation_rule_rotation_analysis: 'full-field spatial mean' -- vector-space mean of (q1,q2) over ALL 64x64 pixels, UNMASKED (no anatomical-validity concept applies to a pure rotation-consistency measurement, exactly as in Stage 14's A6 diagnostic R1). Included here specifically so Scale 5's rotation numbers reproduce Stage 14/A6's R1 result exactly, as an internal consistency check.

explicit_asymmetry_documented_before_exe: Scale 5 is named 'full field' in both analyses but its precise definition differs by analysis type (masked-valid for anatomy, unmasked for rotation) because the two analyses have fundamentally different validity concepts (anatomical target validity vs. no-target-exists-for-a-rotated-image). Scales 0-4 use NO anatomical masking in either analysis: for the anatomy analysis, scales 0-4 are unmasked windowed means of the prediction ONLY, compared against the SAME FIXED anatomical target reduction used throughout (full-valid-mean, i.e. Stage 11's target definition, never itself re-scaled) -- only the predicted side varies by scale, not the target side. A patch is included in the anatomy analysis at every scale using the SAME inclusion rule as Stage 11 (at least one valid target pixel anywhere in the patch), so n_patches is identical across scales 0-4 and 5; this decouples the aggregation WINDOW (a pure property of the model's output grid) from the validity-based INCLUSION rule (a pure property of the target), avoiding a circular or moving-target confound.
anatomical_comparison_metrics: Identical formulas to Stage 11's compute_full_metrics (angular correspondence with Glass's Delta, order-magnitude Pearson/Spearman r with bootstrap 95% CI, tensor similarity D_Q with permutation p) -- reused unmodified, applied once per scale to that scale's (S_pred, phi_pred). These are diagnostic measurements only, NOT new preregistered primary endpoints, and do not alter Stage 11's official Criteria A/B/C verdict.
rotation_consistency_protocol: Identical to Stage 12 in every respect except the scalar reduction: same pooled testA+testB population (2083 patches, no exclusions), same 10-angle grid [0,15,30,37,45,60,90,123,150,173], same model rotation sign convention (skimage angle=+alpha_deg, mode='reflect', order=1), same normalized_equivariance_error formula, same frozen per-angle local_thresholds from preregistered_thresholds_v2.json. Only the (q1,q2) scalar extracted from the dense field at each angle is varied across the 6 frozen scales. Results are reported as pass/fail AGAINST THE ORIGINAL FROZEN STAGE 12 THRESHOLDS for descriptive comparison only -- this is explicitly NOT a new official Criterion D decision at any scale.

population.primary: pooled testA+testB, 80 images, 2083 patches (identical to Stages 11/12/14, no exclusions, fragmented testB images retained)
population.unit_of_analysis: patch for the underlying per-patch statistics (matching Stage 11's own unit of analysis for its bootstrap/permutation procedures, reused unmodified); image count and patch count reported at every scale per instruction section 9

statistical_inference.note: The 6 scales are NOT treated as 6 independent hypotheses requiring multiple-testing correction -- this is a descriptive diagnostic sweep over a single frozen, deterministic function of the same underlying dense prediction, not 6 independently-sampled experiments. No new significance threshold is defined for Stage 16; Stage 12's original >=7/9 threshold is reported for comparison only, never redefined.

prohibitions_restated: No scale is added or removed after seeing any numerical result.
No scale is described as the 'correct' or 'true' scale.
No scale's result is used to modify, retrain, or promote a new Model 3 configuration.
Fragmented testB images (testB_3, testB_11, testB_18, testB_19) are never excluded.
Stage 11 and Stage 12's official verdicts are not altered by any result in this stage.
